add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v6.title: Add File Attachment to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v6.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a FileSpecification with a description, embed it in the document's EmbeddedFiles collection, and save the updated PDF.

embed-local-file-into-pdf.title: Embed a Local File into a PDF
embed-local-file-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, embed a local file as an attachment using FileSpecification, and save the resulting document with Aspose.Pdf.

add-multiple-file-attachments-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple File Attachments to a PDF
add-multiple-file-attachments-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, embedding two files as attachments using FileSpecification, and saving the updated document with Aspose.Pdf.

add-unicode-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Unicode Attachment to PDF
add-unicode-attachment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a file with a Unicode name into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's FileSpecification and saving the updated document.

extract-pdf-attachments-report.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Write Report
extract-pdf-attachments-report.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates all embedded file attachments, and writes each attachment's original file name to a plain‑text report.

extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf__v.title: Extract Embedded Attachments from PDF
extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf__v.description: Loads a PDF file, iterates its EmbeddedFiles collection, and saves each attached file to a specified output folder.

extract-embedded-file-by-index.title: Extract Embedded File from PDF by Index
extract-embedded-file-by-index.description: Shows how to retrieve an embedded file from a PDF using a 1‑based index, copy its contents, and save it to a specified folder with Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-attachment-names-fallback.title: Extract PDF Attachment Names with Fallback
extract-pdf-attachment-names-fallback.description: Demonstrates how to read embedded file names from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, generate fallback names when the Name property is empty, and save the list to a text file.

extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf__v.title: Extract Embedded File Attachments from PDF
extract-embedded-attachments-from-pdf__v.description: Shows how to iterate over a PDF's embedded file specifications, retrieve each attachment's original name, and save the attachment content to disk.

count-embedded-file-attachments.title: Count Embedded File Attachments in PDF
count-embedded-file-attachments.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page's annotations, identifies FileAttachmentAnnotation objects, and reports the total number of embedded file attachments.

extract-pdf-file-attachments.title: Extract File Attachments from PDF
extract-pdf-file-attachments.description: Shows how to locate FileAttachmentAnnotation objects in a PDF document and save their embedded files to a specified folder.

create-pdf-with-multiple-attachments.title: Create PDF with Multiple Attachments and Descriptions
create-pdf-with-multiple-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, embed three different files each with a custom description, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-attachments-and-export-descriptions-.title: Add Attachments to PDF and Export Descriptions to CSV
add-attachments-and-export-descriptions-.description: The example adds file attachments to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, saves the document, then reopens it to enumerate the embedded files and writes each attachment's filename and description to a CSV file.

add-unicode-attachment-to-pdf__v2.title: Add Unicode Attachment to PDF and Verify Name Preservation
add-unicode-attachment-to-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file with a Unicode name into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then reopen the document to confirm the name is preserved.

list-pdf-attachment-names.title: List PDF Attachment Names and Save to Text File
list-pdf-attachment-names.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts the file names of all embedded attachments using FileSpecification.Name, and writes the list to a text file.

embed-file-with-special-char-description.title: Embed File with Special-Character Description and Verify Integrity
embed-file-with-special-char-description.description: Shows how to create a FileSpecification whose description contains special characters, embed the file into a PDF, and reload the PDF to confirm the description is preserved.

add-file-attachment-with-unicode-name-to.title: Add File Attachment with Unicode Name to PDF
add-file-attachment-with-unicode-name-to.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set its UnicodeName property, retrieve it, and save the updated document.

extract-pdf-attachments-manifest.title: Extract PDF File Attachments and Generate Manifest
extract-pdf-attachments-manifest.description: The example iterates through all pages of a PDF, extracts each FileAttachmentAnnotation to a local folder, and creates a JSON manifest that lists the extracted file names and their sizes.

add-multiple-attachments-unique-extracti.title: Add Multiple Attachments with Same Name and Extract with Unique Names
add-multiple-attachments-unique-extracti.description: Creates a PDF, embeds several files that share the same filename, then extracts each attachment and saves them with distinct generated names.

extract-pdf-attachments-summary.title: Extract PDF Attachments and Generate Summary
extract-pdf-attachments-summary.description: The example opens a PDF, extracts all embedded file attachments to a folder, and creates a summary text file that maps each original file name to its extraction path.

add-and-retrieve-file-attachment.title: Add and Retrieve File Attachment in PDF
add-and-retrieve-file-attachment.description: Shows how to load a PDF, attach a file using FileSpecification, save the document, and then retrieve the attachment from the EmbeddedFiles collection.

extract-embedded-and-annotation-attachme.title: Extract Embedded and Annotation Attachments from PDF
extract-embedded-and-annotation-attachme.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing EmbeddedFiles and FileAttachmentAnnotation objects and save all extracted attachments into a single output directory.

add-unicode-attachment-to-pdf__v3.title: Add Unicode-Named Attachment to PDF and Verify
add-unicode-attachment-to-pdf__v3.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file with a Unicode name into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then read back the UnicodeName to confirm it was stored correctly.

remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove All Attachments from PDF
remove-all-attachments-from-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete every embedded file attachment, and save the cleaned document.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v7.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-file-attachment-to-pdf__v7.description: Shows how to open an existing PDF, embed a file as an attachment with a description, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-attachment-to-pdf-from-stream.title: Add Attachment to PDF from Stream
add-attachment-to-pdf-from-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a file attachment from a memory stream, adding it to the document's EmbeddedFiles collection, and saving the updated PDF.

export-pdf-attachments-to-csv.title: Export PDF Attachments to CSV
export-pdf-attachments-to-csv.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its EmbeddedFiles collection, and write each attachment's name and description to a CSV file.

add-file-attachments-to-pdf.title: Add File Attachments to a PDF Document
add-file-attachments-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, embed multiple files with custom descriptions as attachments, and save the combined document using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-attachments-add-new-file-to-pdf.title: Remove All Attachments and Add a New File Attachment to PDF
remove-attachments-add-new-file-to-pdf.description: The example loads a PDF, deletes any existing embedded file attachments, adds a new file as an attachment, and saves the updated document.

extract-pdf-attachments-metadata.title: Extract PDF Attachments Metadata to JSON
extract-pdf-attachments-metadata.description: The example opens a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, reads all embedded file attachments, captures their names and sizes, and writes the information to a formatted JSON report.

count-pdf-attachments.title: Count PDF Attachments and Save to Text File
count-pdf-attachments.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its embedded file attachments, counts them, and writes the attachment count to a text file.

add-file-attachment-annotation__v2.title: Add File Attachment Annotation with Long Description to PDF
add-file-attachment-annotation__v2.description: Shows how to open a PDF, create a FileAttachmentAnnotation with a detailed description, embed a file, and save the PDF while preserving the attachment.

add-attachment-from-memory-stream-to-pdf.title: Add Attachment from Memory Stream to PDF
add-attachment-from-memory-stream-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create an attachment from a memory stream with a custom name, embed it as an embedded file, and save the updated document.

delete-and-add-pdf-attachments.title: Delete All PDF Attachments and Add New File Attachments
delete-and-add-pdf-attachments.description: The example loads a PDF, removes any existing embedded file attachments, then adds three new attachments with distinct descriptions, and finally saves the updated document.

list-pdf-embedded-attachments-summary.title: List PDF Embedded Attachments and Create Summary
list-pdf-embedded-attachments-summary.description: Opens a PDF, enumerates all embedded file attachments, calculates their sizes, and writes a concise summary to a text file.

add-stream-attachment-with-description.title: Add Stream Attachment with Description to PDF and Export Descriptions
add-stream-attachment-with-description.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF from a memory stream, set a custom description for the attachment, save the updated PDF, and write all attachment descriptions to a text file.

remove-attachments-add-stream-attachment.title: Remove All Attachments and Add a Stream Attachment to PDF
remove-attachments-add-stream-attachment.description: Loads a PDF, deletes all embedded file attachments, creates a new attachment from a memory stream, and saves the updated document.

add-file-attachment-and-export-metadata.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and Export Metadata to CSV
add-file-attachment-and-export-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, retrieve its embedded file metadata, and write the information to a CSV file.

calculate-total-attachment-size.title: Calculate Total Size of PDF Attachments
calculate-total-attachment-size.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all embedded file attachments, sums their byte sizes, and writes the total size to a text file.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf-and-verify-em.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and Verify Embedded Files
add-file-attachment-to-pdf-and-verify-em.description: Loads an existing PDF, embeds a text file as an attachment using FileSpecification, saves the document, then reopens it to enumerate embedded files and confirm that exactly one attachment is present.

add-file-attachment-and-retrieve-name.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and Retrieve Its Name
add-file-attachment-and-retrieve-name.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, embed a file attachment with a description, retrieve the attachment's logical name via the EmbeddedFiles collection, and save that name to a text file.

extract-pdf-attachment-names.title: Extract PDF Attachment Names to a Comma‑Separated List
extract-pdf-attachment-names.description: Loads a PDF, reads the names of all embedded file attachments, and writes them as a comma‑separated list to a text file.

add-attachment-to-pdf-from-stream__v2.title: Add Attachment to PDF from Stream and List Embedded Files
add-attachment-to-pdf-from-stream__v2.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF using a memory stream, set a custom description and MIME type, save the document, and then enumerate the embedded files for verification.

delete-attachments-add-file-attachment.title: Delete All Attachments and Add a New File Attachment to PDF
delete-attachments-add-file-attachment.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, removing all embedded file attachments, adding a new file attachment, and saving the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-pdf-attachments-and-list.title: Add Attachments to a PDF and Export Their Names
add-pdf-attachments-and-list.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, embedding multiple files as attachments using Aspose.Pdf, saving the updated document, and writing the attachment filenames to a text file.

add-file-attachment-and-retrieve-descrip.title: Add File Attachment to PDF and Retrieve Its Description
add-file-attachment-and-retrieve-descrip.description: Demonstrates how to embed a file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set a description for the attachment, and then read that description back and save it to a text file.

count-embedded-file-attachments__v2.title: Count Embedded File Attachments in a PDF
count-embedded-file-attachments__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerating its embedded file specifications, counting them, and writing the total to a text report file.

add-pdf-attachments-and-save-description.title: Add Attachments to PDF and Save Descriptions
add-pdf-attachments-and-save-description.description: Loads an existing PDF, embeds two files as attachments, saves the updated PDF, then extracts each attachment's description and writes them to separate text files.
